content: Sɔ̃ɔ teeru Isirelibɑn ɡuro ɡurobu ɡɑbu bɑ nɑ bɑ Esekiɛli deemɑ u kɑ bu bikiɑru kuɑ Gusunɔn mi.
Yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ,
tɔnun bii, tɔn be, bɑ bũu sɑ̃ɑmɔwɑ ben ɡɔ̃ruɔ, mɑ bɑ tii nu wɛ̃, mɑ nu derɑ bɑ wɑ̃ɑ durum sɔɔ. Yerɑ bɑ tɑmɑɑ kon ben bikiɑru wurɑ?

A bu sɔ̃ɔwɔ ɑ nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡeruɑ. Nɑ nɛɛ, Isireli ɡoo ù n tii wɛ̃ bũu sɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ, mɑ tɑ derɑ u torɑmɔ, mɑ u nɑ nɛn sɔmɔ ɡoon mi u kɑ nùn bikiɑru kuɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔn mi, nɛn tiiwɑ kon yɛ̃ro wisi nɡe mɛ̀n nɔɔ win bũnu dɑbiru nɛ.
Nɛn wisi biyɑ bu koo de Isirelibɑ bu bwisiku ben ɡɔ̃ruɔ be, be bɑ mɑn yinɑ ben bũu sɑ̃ɑrun sɔ̃.
Yen sɔ̃, ɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɔ ɑ nɛɛ, nɛnɑ nɑ nɛɛ, bu ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsio kpɑ bu ben bũnu deri kɑ mɑɑ kom kɔ̃sum mɛ bɑ mɔ̀, mɛ mu ǹ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ wɛ̃remɔ.
Isirelibɑn ɡoo ǹ kun mɛ sɔɔ ɡoo ben suunu sɔɔ ù n mɑn deri u bũnu sɑ̃ɑmɔ mɑ tɑ derɑ u torɑmɔ mɑ u nɑ nɛn sɔmɔn mi u kɑ bikiɑru ko nɛn mi, nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔn tiiwɑ kon nùn wisi.
Kon yɛ̃ro wɔriwɑ n sɛɛyɑsiɑ kpɑ u n sɑ̃ɑ seedɑ ye bɑ ko n dɑ kɑ mɔndu ko. Kon nùn wunɑwɑ nɛn tɔmbun suunu sɔɔn di, kpɑ i ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ.
Nɛn sɔmɔ ɡoo ù n wurɑ durɔ wi, u nùn nɔni wɔ̃kuɑ, mɑ u nùn bikiɑru kuɑ, nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ derɑ u kuɑ mɛ. Nɛn tiiwɑ kon sɔmɔ wi wunɑ nɛn tɔmbun suunu sɔɔn di.
Sɔmɔ wi kɑ durɔ wi u bikiɑru nɑ mi, be kpurowɑ bɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑ torobu. Bɑ koo mɑɑ ben torɑ nin ɑre sɔbe.
Nɡe mɛyɑ be Isirelibɑ bɑ ǹ mɑɑ tondɑmɔ nɛn swɑɑn di. Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ ben tii disi dokemɔ kɑ ben torɑ dɑbi ni. Bɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɛn tɔmbu kpɑ nɑ n sɑ̃ɑ ben Yinni. Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Gɑ̃ɑnu sɑri ni nu koo Gusunɔn siribu yɔ̃rɑsiɑ
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ,
tɔnun bii, su tɛ̃ nɛɛ, tem ɡɑm tɔmbu bɑ mɑn mɛm nɔɔbu sɑriru kuɑ. Mɑ nɑ bu nɛn dɑm sɔ̃ɔsi nɑ ben dĩɑnu kɑm koosiɑ nɑ bu ɡɔ̃ɔru kpɛ̃ɛ bɑ ɡbisukumɔ be kɑ ben yɑɑ sɑbenɔ kpuro,
bɑɑ tɔmbu itɑ beni Nɔwɛ kɑ Dɑniɛli kɑ Yoobu bɑ̀ n wɑ̃ɑ mi, bɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ bu tem mɛn tɔmbu kpuro fɑɑbɑ ko ben ɡem sɔ̃. Ben tii tɔnɑwɑ ben ɡem mu koo de bu fɑɑbɑ wɑ. Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Ǹ kun mɛ nɑ̀ n derɑ ɡbeeku yɛɛ yi tem mɛ wɔri yi bu ɡo kpuro kpɑ tem mɛ, mu ko bɑnsu sere ɡoo kun mɑɑ sɑrɔ mi, ɡbeeku yɛɛ yin sɔ̃,

sere kɑ nɛn wɑ̃ɑru, bɑɑ tɔmbu itɑ be, bɑ̀ n wɑ̃ɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ, tem mɛɡibu bɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ bu fɑɑbɑ wɑ. Tɔmbu itɑ be tɔnɑwɑ bɑ koo fɑɑbɑ wɑ, bɑɑ ben tiin bibu bɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ bu fɑɑbɑ wɑ. Mɑ tem mɛ, mu koo kowɑ bɑnsu.
Ǹ kun mɛ nɑ̀ n derɑ bɑ tɔn be tɑbu wɔrimɑ, mɑ bɑ bu kɑm koosiɑ sere kɑ ben yɑɑ sɑbenɔ,
bɑɑ tɔmbu itɑ be, bɑ̀ n wɑ̃ɑ mi, be tɔnɑwɑ bɑ koo fɑɑbɑ wɑ. Sere kɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔn wɑ̃ɑru, bɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ bu mɑm ben tiin bibu fɑɑbɑ ko.
Ǹ kun mɛ nɑ̀ n derɑ bɑrɑrɑ duɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ, mɑ bɑ ɡbisukɑ be kɑ ben yɑɑ sɑbenɔ,

bɑɑ Nɔwɛ kɑ Dɑniɛli kɑ Yoobu bɑ̀ n wɑ̃ɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ, tem mɛn tɔmbu bɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ bu fɑɑbɑ wɑ ben sɔ̃. Be itɑ ye tɔnɑwɑ bɑ koo fɑɑbɑ wɑ ben ɡem sɔ̃. Bɑɑ mɑm ben tiin bibu bɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ bu fɑɑbɑ ko ben ɡem sɔ̃.
Yen biruwɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ, wee nɑ Yerusɑlɛmu wɑhɑlɑ bɑkɑ nnɛ yeni kpɛ̃ɛ n kɑ yen tɔmbu kɑ ben yɑɑ sɑbenu ɡo. Yerɑ tɑbu kɑ ɡɔ̃ɔru kɑ ɡbeeku yɛɛ ɡɔbi kɑ bɑrɑnu.
Adɑmɑ ɡɑbu bɑ koo tiɑrɑ kpɑ bu bu yɑrɑ wuun di, kpɑ bu bɛɛ deemɑ kpiki yeru mi. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, ì n ben dɑɑ kɑ ben kookoosu wɑ, biti kun mɑɑ bɛɛ mɔ̀ kɔ̃sɑ ye nɑ Yerusɑlɛmu kuɑn sɔ̃.
Yɑ koo bɛɛn nukuru yɛmiɑsiɑ ì n ben dɑɑ kɑ ben kookoosu wɑ. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, i ko i ɡiɑ mɑ n ǹ kɑm sɔɔ nɑ bu wɑhɑlɑ yebɑ kpɛ̃ɛ. Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Resɛm dɑ̃ɑ te bɑ dɔ̃ɔ doke
